item.text: On it. I'll have the **Analyst** read your brief against the regulations library first.

messages.text: Brief attached. Find what blocks testable requirements.
Read 3 passages (rbi-digital-payment-security-controls-2021). 4 gaps to ask about.

steps.name: retrieve · BM25 + Chroma
steps.input: Build a digital banking application for retail customers in India. Include secure login, account balances, fund transfers, transaction history and audit logs. Integrate with the core banking system and support 1,000 concurrent users.

steps.name: analyst · Questions
steps.input: Find what the brief leaves unclear that blocks testable requirements. Ask the project owner 3 or 4 short questions about THEIR project (users, business rules, limits, integrations, volumes, who approves releases, data retention), each about one thing, each with 3-4 short answer options; mark the likeliest recommended. Never quiz them about what regulations say.

item.text: A few things in the brief are unclear. I'll ask one at a time — pick an option, write your own, or skip.

questions.text: What is the primary type of users (retail, corporate, or commercial) that this digital banking application is intended for?
questions.why: The brief mentions 'retail customers in India' but does not specify if there are other user types. Knowing the user type helps determine the

questions.text: What is the maximum value of transactions that the application will handle?
questions.why: The brief mentions 'support 1,000 concurrent users' but does not specify transaction values. Knowing the transaction value helps determine

questions.text: Who is responsible for approving releases of the application?
questions.why: The brief does not mention who approves releases. Knowing this helps determine the approval process and responsibilities.

questions.text: What is the data retention policy for audit logs?
questions.why: The brief mentions 'audit logs' but does not specify how long they should be retained. Knowing this helps determine compliance and storage.
